title: TaskConfig
description: Schema for *.taskconfig.json artifacts (kind: task_config). Mirrors taskconfig.TaskConfig (internal/taskconfig/task_config.go) as documented in docs/task-config-reference.md.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this task_config artifact. Only 1 is currently defined.

taskCode.description: Logical task type this config applies to, e.g. 'moh:fcau:health_cert:v1'. If omitted, the artifact's manifest id is used as the effective task code instead.

title.description: Shown in the task list and as the review screen header.

description.description: One-line subtitle shown under the title.

icon.description: Icon hint. The frontend currently only renders 'emoji:<char>'-prefixed values; anything else is ignored.

category.description: Grouping label shown in the task list, e.g. 'Food Control'.

forms.description: review is required — every task is reviewable, enforced by TaskConfig.Validate.

view.description: generic_template id for the read-only rendering of the trader's submitted data. Omit if the task has nothing trader-submitted to show.

review.description: generic_template id for the officer's review action form (approve/reject/etc). Required — every task is reviewable.

behavior.description: Wires the officer's review submission to a final application status. type is required whenever behavior is present at all.

type.description: 'autoApprove': the status resolves unconditionally to APPROVED, no body field is read. 'statusMap': read body[outcomeField] and look it up in statusMap.

outcomeField.description: Required when type is 'statusMap'. Key read from the POST .../review request body.

statusMap.description: Required when type is 'statusMap', with at least one entry. Maps the outcome field's value (e.g. 'approve') to the status stored on the application. Every value must be one of the closed set below; PENDING and DONE are never valid statusMap values.

additionalProperties.description: Terminal statuses APPROVED/REJECTED, or FEEDBACK_REQUESTED to send the task back to the trader.

permissions.description: Per-task, per-role access control. Required and non-empty — a config that omits this fails to load. VIEW and REVIEW must each be granted to at least one role, collectively across all entries; FEEDBACK is optional.

actions.description: Closed set of actions compared verbatim against route requirements: VIEW, REVIEW, FEEDBACK.

allOf.description: At least one permissions entry must grant VIEW.
At least one permissions entry must grant REVIEW.

templateId.description: Id of the certificate template to render. Copied onto Application.CertificateTemplateID.

dataSchema.description: A JSON Schema (validated client-side) describing the shape of the generate-certificate request's data payload. Deliberately separate from forms.review's schema.
